title: Noor and the Asset
author: Sebastian Sandoval
blurb: Hazel Montrose, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
